subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: Should OpenClaw treat this as a core browser/search hardening program now, and which first slice should be sponsored: search-provider reliability, browser/Lightpanda backend design, or the cross-tool benchmark matrix?
rationale: The current issue combines optional browser-engine selection, sandbox/browser security boundaries, provider reliability, and benchmark methodology, so automation cannot safely choose scope or acceptance criteria.

options.title: Split and scope first
options.body: Keep this open as the parent decision item and create narrower implementation issues only after maintainers choose the browser/search boundary and security requirements.

options.title: Route browser runtime slices
options.body: Move the Lightpanda/external-browser pieces under the existing browser-backend and built-in-browser issues while leaving this issue for search-stack matrix work.

options.title: Defer core work
options.body: Decide that Lightpanda evaluation and cross-tool research benchmarking should stay outside core unless it exposes a missing plugin or browser API.

recommendation.title: Split and scope first
recommendation.body: Keep this open as the parent decision item and create narrower implementation issues only after maintainers choose the browser/search boundary and security requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across browser/search hardening and the issue timeline repeatedly routes this topic to that maintainer group.
